COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
SPA No. 776 of 2017
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.
Hon'ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Mr. J.C. Pande, learned Standing Counsel for the
State/appellant.
Ms. Swati Verma proxy counsel for Mr. Subhash
Upadhyay, counsel for respondent.
2. This intra-court appeal is filed by State
Government challenging the judgment dated 28.03.2017
passed by learned Single Judge in WPSS No. 61 of 2017,
whereby writ petition filed by petitioner (respondent
herein) was allowed by directing the Authorities of
Education Department to post the petitioner pursuant to
promotion order dated 31.10.2013 within one month along
with all consequential benefits. Relevant portion of the
said impugned final order is extracted below:
"The petitioner was promoted to the post of Lecturer
vide office order dated 31.10.2013. It is mentioned in SLR
No. 10 of the said order that the Principal of the School
would relieve the concerned teacher within one month.
However, the fact of the matter is that the petitioner
was on materiality leave. She lost her mother-in-law and
father-in-law. She was never informed personally either by
the Principal concerned or by the Office that the petitioner
stood promoted vide office order dated 31.10.2013. The
Principal of the Schol at Nalbasar, Tehri Garhwal has also
certified that on 30.12.2015, the copy of the office order
dated 31.10.2013 was not received by his office. Thus, there
is no fault of the petitioner, since she was not apprised of
the order dated 31.10.2013.
It was in the interest of the petitioner to join her duties
after promotion, if letter dated 31.10.2013 had been
brought to her notice.
Accordingly, the present petition is allowed. The

respondents are directed to post the petitioner pursuant to
the office order dated 31.10.2013 within a period of one
month from today along with all consequential benefits."
3. Learned State counsel would submit that
respondent was earlier serving as Assistant Teacher (L.T.
Grade) and she was promoted to the post of Lecturer vide
order dated 31.10.2013 passed by Additional Director,
Secondary Education, on the recommendation of
Uttarakhand Public Service Commission, Haridwar. He
would further submit that as per the condition mentioned
in para-2 of the promotion order, respondent had to join
her duties on promoted post within one month, but, she
did not join the promoted post, even though time to join
duties on the promoted post was extended by the
authorities time to time and lastly the authorities by
publishing an advertisement on 16.05.2014, extended the
date of joining on the promotional post upto 22.05.2014,
but, respondent did not come forward to join duties on
promoted post, therefore, Authorities had cancelled the
said promotion.
4. Learned State counsel would further submit that
learned Single Judge, while allowing the writ petition did
not consider the averments made in paragraph-3 of
counter affidavit filed by Mr. R.K. Kunwar, Director,
Secondary Education, Uttarakhand, Dehradun. Same is
extracted hereunder:
"3.That the content of para-2 of the writ petition are
denied, as incorrect and misleading. It is stated that after
the recommendation of Uttarakhand Public Service
Commission, Haridwar vide order dated 31.10.2013 of the
Directorate of Intermediate Education, the promotion in

various subjects in General/Women Branch of
Uttarakhand Special Subordinate Education (Lecturers)
Cadre were done. The said promotion order was uploaded
in the Departmental Website, and vide letter dated
31.10.2013 of the Directorate, all the Chief Education
Officers of the State are directed to inform the
promotional orders to the concerned Teachers. The
petitioner Smt. Vinita Uniyal was also informed the
promotion order dated 31.10.2013 of the Directorate,
whereby the petitioner was promoted on the post of
Lecturer Chemistry and posted at G.I.C. Thatibuda Kedar,
Tehri. The petitioner is denied information of the said
promotion order and consequently, she could not join the
promotional post/college, till May 2015 when she got the
information; hence, this writ petition filed by the
petitioner.
In this regard it is pertinent to state here that those
teachers who could not join the promotional post during
time given, therefore, providing them last opportunity till
22.05.2014. The said time was extended, vide
advertisement order dated 16.05.2014 of the Directorate,
in which it is also informed that those teachers who have
not joined the post, their promotion will be deemed
cancelled and they will not be considered for promotion in
coming three years, as per rule. This information was also
circulated through concerned Chief Education Officers,
inspite of this the petitioner had not joined at present in
the month of April/May 2016 the Department has already
permitted the promotional process is in process, in which
the petitioner is also included. In the facts and
circumstances mentioned above after the lapse of three
years, the petitioner cannot be permitted to join the
promotional post."
5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused
the record.
6. Perusal of the record reveals that despite extension
of time to join duties on promoted post, respondent did not
join duties, as per condition mentioned in promotion order
and also in the subsequent notice dated 16.05.2014 issued
by publication in newspaper, therefore, the competent
authority was justified in cancelling the offer of promotion

made to the respondent. Further perusal of the relief clause
in the writ petition reveals that petitioner had sought a
direction to the authorities to consider her case for joining
on the promoted post pursuant the offer of promotion,
however, while allowing the writ petition, learned Single
Judge has directed for posting her on promoted post,
which relief was not even claimed by the respondent.
While allowing the writ petition, stand taken in the
counter affidavit was not even considered and discussed.
Therefore, the impugned order dated 28.03.2017 is liable
to be set aside. Same is hereby set aside.
7. Accordingly, Special appeal would stand allowed.
d
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.)
